title: Test commands Claude runs in a turn it started on a background-task wake get no host test observation
outcome: A recognised test command (built-in or declared) that a Claude session runs in a turn Claude Code starts itself on a background-task completion is either observed and reported like one in a TermAl-prompted turn, or the host states plainly in the next turn that it was not observed and why.
acceptance: A regression reproduces a Claude session that runs a recognised test command in a turn started by a background-task completion (not a TermAl prompt) and shows the host either records a hostObserved test run judged as in a prompted turn, or emits a named host line saying the command was not observed and why.
docs/features/declared-test-commands.md (or the test-runs brief) states which turn kinds are observed.
